ss.story.1.text: Gloop the jelly lives in a wobbly pond by Shape Garden.

ss.story.2.text: Today is the Jelly Party, and all of Gloop's friends are inside!

ss.story.3.text: But every garden gate has a funny shaped hole. Bonk! Gloop can't fit.

ss.story.4.text: Gloop can squish into any shape. Help Gloop find the right gates!

ss.story.mid1.text: Squelch! Gloop is through. The party music is getting louder!

ss.story.mid2.text: Halfway there! Gloop can smell the jelly cake.

ss.story.mid3.text: Just a few more gates, and Gloop is at the party!

ss.story.end1.text: Squish, squelch, pop! Gloop made it to the Jelly Party!

ss.story.end2.text: You counted sides and corners, even when shapes were turned around.

ss.story.end3.text: You earned the Shape Squisher sticker! Next time, trickier gates!

ss.prompt.gate.text: Gloop is a {shape}! Find the {shape} gate.

ss.prompt.sort.text: Sort the shapes by their sides!

ss.prompt.two.text: Which two triangles make a square?

ss.prompt.fill.text: Fill the {shape} gate with jelly pieces!

ss.prompt.twoWays.text: Fill both {shape} gates, each a different way!

ss.help.explain.text: Count the sides and corners. Turning a shape never changes it!

ss.help.hint.text: Let's trace the sides with my pencil and count them. One, two, three!

ss.praise.1.text: Squish! You checked the sides and corners.

ss.praise.2.text: You looked carefully at every shape!

ss.praise.4.text: Squelch! You kept looking until it fit.

ss.hint.show.text: Watch me trace the sides. Then you try!

ss.hint.yourTurn.text: Your turn! Press the glowing one.

ss.nofit.text: Hmm, that piece doesn't fit there. Try another!

ss.full.text: No gaps! Press Squish when you're ready.

ss.idle.text: Drag a shape, or tap it. Count its sides!
